item.tib: mkha' klong gsang ba'i bsad mdel
item.coloph: yul ni khrims sde kun gsal du/ bon gshen mkhas pa mang 'dus nas/ mkha' klong gsang ba'i mdos chen byas/ gug ge'i mi sde cham la phabs/ de nas hris pa gyer med la/ se rab rgyal po dgra ru lang / bsad pa mdos (kyi) 'khrul 'khor bcas/ des kyang phyi ma'i gnas su bsgral/ de nas zhang zhung pra phud la/ nye ba dgra ru lang pa la/ mkha' klong gsang ba'i mdos chen bshams/ de yang brnag pas gran du bsgral/ de nas gshen rabs rim gyis ni/ bsad mdos bcas shing gran rnams bsgral/ de nas gshen rabs rim gyis phyag tu bsnams/ dmu tsa gyer med khong la gdams/ len gcig dus kyi rgyal po yi/ g.yung drung bon gyis (gyi) sde rnams kun/ rin chen gter mdzod kun du sbas/ sgrub khang gting rdzogs sde rnams/ zhi khro pang khong la sogs rnams/ dran pa thugs kyi gsang gter du/ dmu tsa gyer med ra sangs kyis/ phyi rabs gshen gyi don du/ rgyung srub gsang ba'i brag la sbas/ hris pa'i smon lam mthu btsan pas/ gsang bon gcig gis rnyed par shog bskang (skong) ba'i rgyal po zil gnon pas/ sgrub khang gting rdzogs zhal yang phyes/ nges byas bon yin sgrogs par bya/ de nas go le rim gyis spel/ nor bu lta bu 'gyur ba yin/ kun du dar zhing 'phel ba'i rgyu/ log rtog ngan pa zhi bar 'gyur/ dam nyams rgyal blon ru tra'i sde/ rje srog 'bangs kyis bcad rgyud yin/ mkhas mang g.yung drung bon dar 'gyur/ ces gsungs so/ u ya smrar ro/ /de nas 'or sgom gyis dka' ba spyad nas/ lcags pho sprel bu lo la thon/ yas btsun bdag la gnang ba'o//
